This script downloads all basemap grids within the Circumpolar South region for a specific year.

# Define Functions
This needs to be updated to just remove the order_id directory within the delivery directory.
```{python}
def rename_data_files(old_path):
    new_path = re.sub(
        "global_quarterly_2025q3_mosaic/",
        "global_quarterly_2025q3_mosaic_",
        re.sub("/[a-z0-9-]{36}/", "/", old_path),
    )

    return new_path
```

# Import Data

```{python}
# | scrolled: true
grids_filtered = gpd.read_file(

grids_filtered
```

# Order Imagery
From 2024 training data download, we can expect about 39 grids/minute. These orders will cover 259783 grids.

```{python}
expected_delivery_time = grids_filtered.shape[0] / 39 / 60 / 24  # in days
expected_delivery_time
```

```{python}
# | code_folding: []
# | scrolled: true

# record time downloads started
start = datetime.now()
print("Downloads started at ", start)

pl = Planet()


def list_running_orders():
    orders = list(pl.orders.list_orders(state="running"))
    return orders


running_orders = list_running_orders()

while len(running_orders) != 0:
    print("Orders are still running! Waiting.")
    time.sleep(30)
    running_orders = list_running_orders()


# Planet packages orders in a folder with the order ID,
# I am using the column/row combination as the order name
# item_id will be saved in the order_log file to check for prior downloads

# Get prior orders from GCS
blobs = bucket.list_blobs(prefix=delivery_directory)
files = [file for file in blobs if re.search("quad", file.name)]
prior_ids = [
    re.search("\\d{1,4}-\\d{1,4}", file.name.split("/")[-1]).group() for file in files
]

for index, row in grids_filtered.iterrows():
    basemap_name = row["basemap_name"]
    item_id = [row["id"]]  # only deliver a single item at a time
    delivery_location = row[
        "delivery_location"
    ]  # delivery_location includes the row number

    print("-------------------------------------")
    print(index, ": ", item_id[0])

    if item_id[0] not in prior_ids:  # check if the basemap has already been delivered
        # create the order info
        order_info = {
            "name": item_id[0],
            "source_type": "basemaps",
            "products": [{"mosaic_name": basemap_name, "quad_ids": item_id}],
            "delivery": {
                "google_cloud_storage": {
                    "bucket": bucket_name,
                    "credentials": gcs_key,
                    "path_prefix": delivery_location,
                }
            },
            "tools": [{"file_format": {"format": "COG"}}],
        }

        # Place order
        print(
            "Requesting item for delivery to " + bucket_name + "/" + delivery_location
        )
        request = requests.post(
            "https://api.planet.com/compute/ops/orders/v2",
            auth=(api_key, ""),
            json=order_info,
        )
        print(request.status_code)
        print(request.text)  # raw body as string
        print(request.headers)  # see content-type etc.

        if str(request) == "<Response [202]>":
            print("Order has been placed.")
        else:
            print(request.json())
            if str(request) in ["<Response [400]>", "<Response [401]>"] and index == 0:
                sys.exit("Invalid request or credentials. Check your request.")
            if str(request) == "<Response [400]>" and index > 0:
                while str(request) == "<Response [400]>":
                    print(
                        "Credentials could not be verified. Retrying in 30 seconds..."
                    )
                    time.sleep(30)
                    request = requests.post(
                        "https://api.planet.com/compute/ops/orders/v2",
                        auth=(api_key, ""),
                        json=order_info,
                    )
            if str(request) == "<Response [409]>":
                while str(request) == "<Response [409]>":
                    print("Concurrency error. Retrying in 30 seconds...")
                    time.sleep(30)
                    request = requests.post(
                        "https://api.planet.com/compute/ops/orders/v2",
                        auth=(api_key, ""),
                        json=order_info,
                    )
            if str(request) == "<Response [500]>":
                while str(request) == "<Response [500]>":
                    print("Server error. Retrying in 30 seconds...")
                    time.sleep(30)
                    request = requests.post(
                        "https://api.planet.com/compute/ops/orders/v2",
                        auth=(api_key, ""),
                        json=order_info,
                    )

    else:
        print("Item already delivered. Skipping order.")

end = datetime.now()
print("Downloads finished at ", end)
total_time = end - start
print("Dowloading ", len(grids_filtered), " grids took ", total_time)
```

# Construct Renaming Logic
## Find Files to be renamed

```{python}
pl = Planet()


def list_running_orders():
    orders = list(pl.orders.list_orders(state="running"))
    return orders


running_orders = list_running_orders()

while len(running_orders) != 0:
    print("Orders are still running! Waiting.")
    time.sleep(30)
    running_orders = list_running_orders()

print("All orders have been delivered. Proceeding to renaming.")
# Get files to be renamed from GCS
blobs = bucket.list_blobs(prefix=delivery_directory)
all_files = [file for file in blobs]

original_files = [file for file in all_files if re.search("/[a-z0-9-]{36}/", file.name)]
original_names = [file.name for file in original_files]
```

## Construct New Names for Data Files

```{python}
renaming_guide = pd.DataFrame({"blob": original_files, "old_name": original_names})
renaming_guide["new_name"] = renaming_guide.old_name.apply(rename_data_files)
renaming_guide = renaming_guide.loc[renaming_guide.old_name != renaming_guide.new_name]
renaming_guide.to_csv(
    "data/planet_renaming_guide_" + datetime.today().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S") + ".csv",
    index=False,
    mode="x",
)
```

## Create List of Old Directories to Delete

```{python}
# StorageControlClient is used for HNS-specific operations like folders
control_client = storage_control_v2.StorageControlClient()

project_path = control_client.common_project_path("_")
bucket_path = f"{project_path}/buckets/{bucket_name}"

# List folders at the root, or pass a prefix for a specific path
folders = control_client.list_folders(
    request={
        "parent": bucket_path,
        "prefix": delivery_directory + "/",
    }
)

all_folders = [folder for folder in folders]
directories_to_delete = sorted(
    [
        folder.name.replace("projects/_/buckets/pdg-planet-data/folders/", "")
        for folder in all_folders
        if re.search("/[a-z0-9-]{36}/", folder.name)
    ],
    reverse=True,
)
```

# Rename Files
Rename all files (both data files and manifests) using bucket.copy_blob within a concurrent.futures multithreading process. Then delete all original blobs in one call.

## Copy

```{python}
start = datetime.now()


def copy_blobs(blob, new_name):
    bucket.copy_blob(blob, bucket, new_name)


with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor() as executor:
    executor.map(
        copy_blobs,
        list(renaming_guide.blob)[0 : len(renaming_guide.blob)],
        list(renaming_guide.new_name)[0 : len(renaming_guide.new_name)],
    )

end = datetime.now()
print(f"Copying all old files took {end - start}.")
```

## Delete

### Batch Delete Files
~ 2500 files per minute

```{python}
expected_deletion_time = len(original_names) / 2500 / 60 + len(directories_to_delete) / 2500 / 60  # in hours
expected_deletion_time
```

```{python}
# Get names of newly copied files
blobs = bucket.list_blobs(prefix=delivery_directory)
all_files = [file for file in blobs]
new_files = [file for file in all_files if not re.search("/[a-z0-9-]{36}/", file.name)]
new_names = [file.name for file in new_files]
# check that all files are accounted for
len(original_files) + len(new_files) == len(all_files)
```

```{python}
# this will remove duplicates from compare the count of original files with the count of new files if certain images were accidentally ordered and delivered twice

new_filenames = set(
    [
        file.rsplit("/", 1)[1].replace("global_quarterly_2025q3_mosaic_", "")
        for file in new_names
    ]
)

print(len(original_filenames))
print(len(new_filenames))
```

```{python}
def delete_w_retry(blob, max_attempts=5):
    wait_time = 4  # Start with 4 seconds
    for attempt in range(max_attempts):
        try:
            blob.delete()
            break  # Exit loop if successful
        except ValueError as e:
            if "Too many deferred requests" in str(e):
                time.sleep(wait_time)
                wait_time *= 2  # Double the wait time
            else:
                raise  # Re-raise if it's a different error


if len(new_filenames) == len(
    original_filenames
):  # check that all files have been copied before deleting
    start = datetime.now()
    batch_size = 1000

    batches = [
        original_files[i : i + batch_size]
        for i in range(0, len(remaining_original_files), batch_size)
    ]
    # # Use these lines instead of the line above if re-running
    # remaining_original_files = [
    #     file
    #     for file in bucket.list_blobs(prefix=delivery_directory)
    #     if re.search("/[a-z0-9-]{36}/", file.name)
    # ]

    # batches = [
    #     remaining_original_files[i : i + batch_size]
    #     for i in range(0, len(remaining_original_files), batch_size)
    # ]

    print("Beginning deletions...")
    for batch in batches:
        # Delete all old blobs
        with storage_client.batch():
            for blob in batch:
                delete_w_retry(blob)

    end = datetime.now()
    print(f"Deleting all old files took {end - start}.")
elif len(new_filenames) < len(original_filenames):
    print(
        f"Length of new names ({len(new_names)}) is less than length of old names ({len(all_names)}). Attempting to copy these files again..."
    )
    missing_names = original_filenames - new_filenames
    print(missing_names)

    if len(missing_names) > 0:
        renaming_redo = renaming_guide[
            renaming_guide.old_name.str.contains(
                "|".join(["/" + item for item in list(missing_names)])
            )
        ]

        start = datetime.now()

        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor() as executor:
            executor.map(
                copy_blobs,
                list(renaming_redo.blob)[0 : len(renaming_redo.blob)],
                list(renaming_redo.new_name)[0 : len(renaming_redo.new_name)],
            )

        end = datetime.now()
        print(f"Copying all old files took {end - start}.")

else:
    print(
        "There are no outstanding files to be copied. You can delete the old files manually."
    )
```

### Delete Remaining Empty Directories

```{python}
control_client = storage_control_v2.StorageControlClient()

for path in directories_to_delete:
    folder_name = control_client.folder_path(
        project="_", bucket="pdg-planet-data", folder=path
    )
    try:
        request = storage_control_v2.DeleteFolderRequest(
        name=folder_name,
    )
        control_client.delete_folder(request = request)
    except:
        print(f"Skipping {path}")
```
